title: A Letter to the Bank
text:
Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing about my bank account. Last month, I received a bill for twenty pounds, but I did not use the service. Please check my account and send me a reply within two weeks.

Thank you for your help. You can send your answer by email or by post. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours sincerely, Anna Brown.

questions.text: What did the writer receive last month?
options: A phone call from the bank

questions.text: How can the bank send its reply?
Why does the writer write this letter?
options: She wants the bank to correct a mistake
She wants to open a new account
She wants to thank the bank
She wants to close her friend's account

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the bill?

vocabulary.definition: a record of money held by a bank for a customer
a written request for payment for a service
an answer to a letter, message or question
before the end of a period of time

paragraph_translations: Estimado Sr. Smith, le escribo sobre mi cuenta bancaria. El mes pasado recibí una factura de veinte libras, pero no utilicé el servicio. Por favor, revise mi cuenta y envíeme una respuesta dentro de dos semanas.
Gracias por su ayuda. Puede enviar su respuesta por correo electrónico o por correo postal. Espero su respuesta. Atentamente, Anna Brown.
